    Cancellation and chain-boundedness pass to the universal cover #

    Morphisms of the cover are determined by their values (val_injective), so left and right cancellation pass from P to Cover x₀. A factorization in P between morphisms of the cover with a common target (or source) lifts to the cover, so peaks and valleys of the cover project to peaks and valleys of P; hence chains project to chains and chain-boundedness passes to the cover (chainBounded_cover).
